clue.text: Show nature god has to act silently

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of the wild and of nature
to mime is to perform without speaking

explanation.surface: A woodland deity is told he must perform without words.
explanation.walkthrough: PANTOMIME is a British Christmas stage show, a comic play based loosely on a fairy story; 'has' is just a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantomime is a kind of theatrical entertainment, so it is a type of stage production.

clue.text: Musicians' Union go-slow?

parts.note: a trade union's go-slow is industrial action, but read as an instruction among musicians it is a marking telling the players to take the tempo slowly

explanation.surface: A trade union for players is staging a work-to-rule protest.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian tempo marking asks performers for a slow, leisurely pace, the musical counterpart of a go-slow.

clue.text: Poor stuff, but it's held hard to beat

indicators.note: held means one piece keeps another inside it, here the rubbish holding the hard letter

parts.note: trash is rubbish, worthless material
H is the standard abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Something of poor quality is nevertheless considered hard to outdo.
explanation.walkthrough: 'held' puts H inside TRASH; 'but it's' and 'to' are link words, with 'to beat' read as the verb.
explanation.definitionFit: To thrash someone is to defeat them soundly or flog them, both senses of beat.

clue.text: Mixture of rum and tea for adult

indicators.note: a mixture blends things together, so the letters of the two drinks are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A grown-up's drink is a blend of rum and tea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mixture of' rearranges RUM and TEA; 'and' joins them and 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Mature describes someone fully grown, the same as being grown-up.

clue.text: I can't speak, being plastered perhaps

definitions.meaning: a refusal to reveal a secret, saying one is not able to talk
with sticking plaster stuck across the mouth, the speaker is literally shut up

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is a promise of secrecy, and literally describes a mouth closed with tape or plaster.

clue.text: Roughly treat chap with title

parts.note: a chap is a man
a handle is slang for a name or title

explanation.surface: A man with a title is given rough handling.
explanation.definitionFit: To manhandle someone is to push them around physically, treating them rough.

clue.text: Private army loses maiden to be office girl

parts.note: private means secret, not public

indicators.note: loses means a letter is dropped from the word army

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A soldier without a girlfriend takes a job in an office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Private' looks like a soldier's rank but means SECRET; 'loses' drops M from ARMY to leave ARY.
explanation.definitionFit: A secretary handles typing and admin, and the clue uses the dated image of a female clerk.

clue.text: Youth's period as vegetarian?

definitions.meaning: the time of youthful inexperience, from Shakespeare's Cleopatra
taken literally, days spent eating only greens would be a meat-free spell

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom names the carefree time of being young; literally it suggests living on greens.

clue.text: Period by river for one producing picture

parts.note: the Cam is the river through Cambridge
an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: A time spent beside a river results in a painting.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' puts the two pieces next to each other; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A camera is a device that takes photographs, so it makes images.

clue.text: Grim-sounding piece, an unlikely story

definitions.meaning: Grim sounds like Grimm, the brothers who collected folk stories
a far-fetched account that nobody believes

explanation.definitionFit: The Brothers Grimm wrote enchanted folk stories, and the term also means an incredible lie.

clue.text: Mountain guide finds her in spring

indicators.note: in places the pronoun inside the word for the spring

parts.note: a spa is a mineral spring
taken as written

explanation.surface: A climbing guide discovers a woman at a spring.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spring' reads as a season but is a mineral-water resort; 'finds' is only a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Sherpas are Himalayan people famed as climbing porters and guides on Everest.

clue.text: Formal suiting restrains stomach

parts.note: pins means holds down or restrains
tripe is cow's stomach eaten as food

explanation.surface: A smart suit is tight around the belly.
explanation.definitionFit: Pinstripe cloth, with thin lines, is the classic fabric of a business suit.

clue.text: Football team not in division?

definitions.meaning: many clubs are called ..., such as Manchester ...
joined together rather than split apart

explanation.definitionFit: United is a common club name, and also means joined as one, the opposite of split.

clue.text: Right in the middle of the ocean

definitions.text: Right in the middle of the ocean

parts.words: Right in the middle of the ocean
parts.note: not exactly central at sea, but the word sailors use for right when afloat

explanation.surface: Something lies exactly in the centre of the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: On a ship the right-hand side looking forward has its own nautical term.

clue.text: Bluff in dangerous situation

definitions.meaning: a bluff is a steep cliff
figuratively, being on the edge of disaster

explanation.definitionFit: A precipice is a sheer cliff face, and figuratively the brink of disaster.

clue.text: On drive, is forced round by this?

definitions.text: On drive, is forced round by this?

indicators.note: forced suggests being pushed out of the normal shape, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Motorists on a road find themselves sent the long way round.
explanation.walkthrough: 'forced' rearranges ON DRIVE IS, and the whole clue describes what a road detour does to drivers.
explanation.definitionFit: A diversion is an alternative route that traffic must take when a road is closed.

clue.text: Whip Tom

definitions.meaning: the ...-o'-nine-tails is a whip with several knotted cords
a tom is a male feline

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a flogging lash and also a domestic feline, of which a tom is the male.

clue.text: Arrest using firm pressure

parts.note: Co is the abbreviation for company, a firm
P is the scientific symbol for pressure

explanation.surface: Police make an arrest using firm pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: To cop someone is informal for nabbing or catching them.

clue.text: Metal used in plating

indicators.note: used in signals that the letters sit inside the word plating

explanation.surface: A metal employed for coating objects.
explanation.definitionFit: Tin is a chemical element, a soft silvery metal.

clue.text: Might they make a military terror?

definitions.text: Might they make a military terror?

indicators.note: make suggests building something new out of these letters, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: Asks whether part-time soldiers could become a fearsome fighting force.
explanation.walkthrough: 'make' rearranges A MILITARY TERROR; the TERRITORIAL ARMY was Britain's volunteer reserve force.
explanation.definitionFit: Britain's reserve force of volunteer soldiers was called by this name until 2014.

clue.text: Write, with enclosure

definitions.meaning: to ... a letter is to write it

explanation.definitionFit: The word means to compose in writing and also a small fenced pound for livestock.

clue.text: One would be mad not to be on this chair

definitions.text: One would be mad not to be on this chair

parts.words: One would be mad not to be on this chair
parts.note: a person who is off this kind of chair is said to be crazy, so staying on it means staying sane

explanation.surface: Someone would be foolish not to sit in this seat.
explanation.walkthrough: The idiom 'off one's rocker' means mad.
explanation.definitionFit: A rocking chair sits on curved runners; being off it is slang for crazy.

clue.text: Remember to phone again

explanation.definitionFit: To recall is to bring to mind, and literally to ring someone a second time.

clue.text: Shed next to the French chateau

parts.note: to cast is to shed, as a snake casts its skin
le is the French for the

explanation.surface: A garden hut stands beside a French manor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'next to' joins the two pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A chateau is a French castle or grand country house.

clue.text: Shows anger as pound is added into travel costs

indicators.note: is added into means one piece is put inside the other

parts.note: fares are the prices paid for travel
L is the abbreviation for pound sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Someone loses their temper when a pound is put on ticket prices.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is added into' puts L inside FARES; 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: When temper flares, it blazes up suddenly, as anger erupts.

clue.text: Each in turn is to break with colleague

parts.note: to sever is to break off
an ally is a partner or colleague

explanation.surface: Each person in turn must split with their associate.
explanation.definitionFit: Severally means separately or individually, one by one.

clue.text: Resist work attitude

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work
a pose is an attitude or posture

explanation.surface: Someone resists a stance at work.
explanation.definitionFit: To oppose is to stand against or fight something.

clue.text: Related to smell of old lake plant

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for lake, as on maps
a plant is an industrial works or factory

explanation.surface: A stench coming from an aged lakeside industrial site.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plant' looks botanical but is an industrial works; 'of' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Olfactory is the adjective for the sense of scent.

clue.text: Warm over city — bird flies round

indicators.note: flies round says the bird circles the city, holding it inside

parts.note: a rook is a black bird of the crow family
EC is the postcode for the City of London

explanation.surface: Over the city a bird circles in the warm air.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Warm over' looks like weather, but means reheat food; 'City' with a capital is London's financial district, postcode EC.
explanation.definitionFit: To recook food is to heat it up again, reheating leftovers.

clue.text: Flower may be seen as weeds? Lies!

indicators.note: may be seen as hints the letters, viewed differently, form another word

explanation.surface: Someone claims an alpine bloom is really weeds, and is called a liar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may be seen as' rearranges WEEDS and LIES into the flower's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Edelweiss is a white alpine bloom, symbol of Switzerland and Austria.
